newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds end up on well-received auction.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds end up on well-received auction.

text.p: Argentine bonds finished higher Tuesday after a well-received auction of $750 million five year Bonte treasury bonds.
Traders predicted there could be more gains on the back of arbitrage opportunities between the new bond and existing papers with similar durations, such as the FRB and "Pre 4."
"The Bonte auction came in very well," said a trader.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was up 1/4 at 93-1/8, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was $0.40 higher at 115.65.
